summary: Israeli production traffic billed at EU pricing tier — VAT and conversion adjustment requested
description:
Issue summary:
Customer Nexa Diagnostics reports that a portion of February production usage originating from their Israel region (il-west) was billed on the invoice at EU pricing and had EU VAT applied. The customer uses a dedicated account with regional routing configured; they expect IL-region usage to be billed at the APAC/MiddleEast pricing tier with VAT handling for Israel.

Impact:
- A single finalized invoice (Invoice #ND-2026-02-18) includes ~420k tokens billed at eu-west rates (~€0.00014/token) instead of the expected il-tier rate (ILS conversion or apac/middleeast tier).
- Applied tax line shows 17% VAT (EU) instead of Israel VAT treatment; customer-facing finance flagged potential tax liability mismatch.
- Autopay attempted and failed due to resulting currency mismatch on file; customer is asking for interim credit and corrected invoice to avoid collections action.

Environment:
- Customer environment: production (dedicated) routed through regional routing policies.
- Affected time window: 2026-02-17 22:15 UTC -> 2026-02-18 03:45 UTC.
- Region tags on postbacks: some postbacks carry region tag "eu-west-1" despite originating from IL NATed IPs (per customer network topology).

Steps to reproduce / investigation steps performed so far:
1) Customer provided sample usage_payloads and invoice lines for the affected window.
2) Support ran metering reconciliation query joining usage_postbacks with org_region_map for Nexa org id (org_92702) and found ~1.8k postbacks where org_region resolved to eu-west-1 during the window.
3) Checked recent deploys to billing service between 2026-02-16 and 2026-02-18 for any geo-tagging changes (deployed billing service commit 3a4f11c to main on 2026-02-16).
4) Cross-referenced network NAT logs from customer (provided) showing egress IPs in an IP range that our geolocation service maps to EU provider CDN (due to a CDN edge routing change).
5) Confirmed invoice finalized; attempted to issue provisional credit but internal policy requires upstream reconciliation with tax/legal before reversing VAT lines.

Observed behavior:
- Metering service accepted postbacks and attributed region = eu-west-1 for those postbacks; pricing lookup used eu-west tier resulting in EU price and VAT.

Expected behavior:
- Metering should attribute region based on customer org routing override for Nexa (org_92702) that forces il-west for all requests originating from their dedicated pool, regardless of public IP geolocation.

Logs / sample artifacts attached by customer:
- invoice_nd_2026-02-18.pdf (excerpt lines 12-18)
- usage_samples.json (10 payloads)
- customer_nat_ranges.csv

Requested outcome from customer:
- Interim credit equal to the overcharged amount for the affected lines and an adjusted invoice with correct pricing and VAT treatment.
- Root cause explanation and steps to prevent recurrence.

Patch prepared to consult org_region_map first. Rolling to staging 2026-02-24; schedule prod rollback/patch 2026-02-25 03:00 UTC after verification.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: GeoIP provider changed ASN mappings for the CDN used by Nexa's NAT, causing requests to appear EU-based. Since pricing lookup consulted GeoIP before org_region override, eu-tier was used.
Hypothesis 2: Recent billing microservice deploy (commit 3a4f11c) changed lookup order between org-region overrides and geoip fallback; unit tests missed because of mocked env.

Query used to surface affected postbacks: SELECT count(*) FROM usage_postbacks WHERE org_id='org_92702' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-02-17T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-02-18T04:00:00Z' AND region='eu-west-1'; result 1807 rows.

Confirmed matching IP ranges from customer map to ASN that our GeoIP provider currently classifies as EU. Customer confirms they recently switched CDN edge provider on 2026-02-16 which coincides with anomaly window.

Billing service code review: file pricing/region_resolver.go shows fallback order changed in PR 3a4f11c; created follow-up PR to re-prioritize org-region map ahead of geoip (PR reference: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/412).
resolution:
Workaround and next steps: provisional credit ILS 3,400 applied on 2026-02-22 to avoid autopay. Patch to billing service merged to staging on 2026-02-24 and scheduled for production 2026-02-25 03:00 UTC. After production deploy we will: 1) re-run metering reconciliation for the affected window, 2) produce an adjusted invoice with corrected pricing lines and VAT treatment, and 3) if tax/legal approves, reissue final invoice and reverse the EU VAT line.

Follow-up actions assigned:
- Miguel Santos: finalize prod deploy and run reconciliation (due 2026-02-25).
- Priya Iyer (Tax): advise on VAT reversal policy and prepare supporting evidence for Nexa (due 2026-02-26).
- Customer Success (Asha Patel): notify Nexa of timeline and confirm receipt of provisional credit.

If reconciliation shows any additional windows affected, we will include those in the adjusted invoice. Customer asked for formal postmortem and preventative controls (alerting on sudden region entropy for an org); recommending a monitoring rule to surface when >5% of an org's postbacks in a 1h window change region tag compared to the preceding 24h baseline.
resolution_status: Partial workaround applied (provisional credit). Final invoice correction pending reconciliation and tax sign-off.
